heading: Duplicate charges
body: If you see two charges for the same invoice, the second is usually a pending authorization that drops off within 3 business days. If both charges posted, we refund the duplicate automatically.

heading: Downloading invoices
body: Invoices are available under Settings > Billing. Each monthly invoice lists the plan, seats and taxes.

heading: Updating a payment method
body: Add a new card under Settings > Billing > Payment methods, then set it as default. The old card can then be removed.

heading: Sales tax and VAT
body: We collect VAT for customers in the EU. Enter your VAT number to be exempted.

heading: Refund policy
body: Annual plans can be cancelled within 30 days for a full refund. Monthly plans are not refunded for partial months.

heading: When will my refund arrive
body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Banks take 5 to 10 business days to show the money back on your statement.

heading: Cancelling an order
body: You can cancel an order before it ships from the Orders page. Cancelled orders are refunded to the original card.

heading: Tracking a shipment
body: Each shipped order has a tracking number in the confirmation email.

heading: App crashes on upload
body: If the app closes while uploading photos or images, update to the latest version and allow photo library access. Large videos over 2 GB are not supported.

heading: Working offline
body: Changes made offline sync when the device reconnects.

heading: Push notifications
body: Enable notifications in your phone settings and in the app under Profile > Notifications.

heading: Changing your email address
body: Go to Profile > Account and edit the email field. We send a confirmation link to the new address before the change takes effect.

heading: Resetting your password
body: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after one hour.

heading: Two-factor authentication
body: Turn on two-factor authentication under Security. Keep your recovery codes safe; support cannot bypass 2FA.

heading: Deleting your account
body: Account deletion is permanent and removes all projects after 14 days.

heading: Cannot sign in
body: If you cannot log in, check caps lock, reset your password, and make sure SSO is not required by your organization.

heading: Phishing and spam
body: We never ask for your password by email. Report suspicious messages, prize offers or links to abuse@example.com and do not click them.

heading: Inviting teammates
body: Admins can invite members by email from the Team page. Each invite uses one seat.

heading: Roles and permissions
body: Owners manage billing; admins manage members; members edit projects.

heading: API keys
body: Create API keys under Developer settings. Keys are shown once; rotate them if leaked.

heading: Rate limits
body: The API allows 100 requests per minute per key. A 429 response means you hit the limit.

heading: Exporting your data
body: Export all projects as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data export.

heading: Upgrading your plan
body: Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated on the next invoice.

heading: Downgrading your plan
body: Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.
